annotations.title: Look up an agent or tool

description: The public record of an agent or tool: give its endpoint URL, registry name or agent id, for example 'https://gt.llpro.ai/mcp' or 'ai.llpro.countersign/countersign'. Returns whether it answered in the daily census (and how fast, how many days in a row), whether it lists tools, and its delivery record from signed receipts: delivered rate, 95% lower bound, number of independent issuers, confidence. Only exact matches (match=exact) carry a record. Free: 20 lookups a day per agent (more with a name or a signed id), shared with Agent Record search; no paid placement. Free daily quota; credit keys from $1 at llpro.ai/pay/credit; x402 accepted. Send the key as Authorization: Bearer <llk_ key>. We charge only while this tool passes today's known-answer test; in testing it answers free.
